audit_items.proof_trace: Full repayment (debt_amount <= amount) calls debt.cleared() setting amount to zero; the subsequent check !debt.has_debt() evaluates to true and wit_table::remove is called, removing the entry from both the underlying Table and VecSet. The else branch (partial repayment) only executes when ceil(actual_debt) > amount, guaranteeing the remaining debt is strictly positive so has_debt() remains true and no removal occurs.
